text: I am writing to [state the purpose of the letter in one clear sentence — for example, to apply for a role, to request information, or to follow up on a previous conversation].
In this paragraph, give the details that support your purpose: the background, the facts, and anything the reader needs to understand the request. Keep it short and specific — one idea per paragraph.
In the final paragraph, say clearly what you would like the reader to do next, and thank them for their time and consideration.
